_comment: Release-change lane (query.release_diff). annotation_lines: line-anchored, case-insensitive regexes for document bookkeeping that the parser leaves inside a requirement's body. A pair whose texts are equal once these lines are removed is reported as a one-line note per plan, not sent to the model; the lines are also removed from the text the model sees. model: pin the lane to one model regardless of the Ask page's choice (empty = the page's).
